collection.description: An apprentice studying animals wonders whether a failing body part could be replaced by one from a recently deceased donor.

setup.name: The setup
setup.text: An apprentice studying animals wonders whether a failing body part could be replaced by one from a recently deceased donor.

choices.label: Discuss the proposal openly with the patient.
Seek the donor's prior consent and study anatomy without operating.
Focus on preventing the illness that damaged the organ.

a1.name: Outcome A1
a1.text: The patient declines an operation no healer can yet perform safely.

a2.name: Outcome A2
a2.text: The patient is willing, but the healers agree the risks are overwhelming.

b1.name: Outcome B1
b1.text: The healer learns about the organ's blood vessels and the limits of their tools.

b2.name: Outcome B2
b2.text: The donor's family declines, and the healer respects the decision.

c2.name: Outcome C2
c2.text: The research does not save this patient but helps protect others.

c1__fx.name: Outcome C1
c1__fx.text: The healer improves access to clean drinking water.
